newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Eastern Nova loading 55,650 tonnes soybeans. Cedymia loading 26,677 tonnes soymeal. Kalma loading 28,700 tonnes soymeal. Kamenitza loading 21,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, eight vessels to load soymeal, three to load soybeans and two for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal).
Road: 360 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on July 31, as well as 115 trucks with soymeal and 68 trucks with vegetable oils, including soyoil.

Vessels: At public terminal, Cornilios loading 51,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 12,000 tonnes soybeans and one to load 30,000 tonnes soybeans. At Cutrale terminal, Lika loading 60,000 tonnes soymeal. No vessels docked at Cargill private terminal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 57,500 tonnes soymeal.
Road: 83 trucks carrying 2,118 tonnes soybeans arrived on July 31.
Rail: 22 wagons arrived with 944 tonnes of soymeal.
